This berry is found chiefly in hot and humid climates, especially in jungles and rainforests, and is best known in southern Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains almost impossible to find.

To obtain its properties, it is consumed directly.

The berry prevents an injured person’s condition from deteriorating for four days and allows healing to work at full effectiveness. It keeps for several months.

Repeated doses can lead to significant dependence.
